name: Decoder
author: HamDash
description: Decode digital modes from the radio's audio. CW for now

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Only CW decodes so far. The card's own dropdown lists what else is planned.

source.label: Audio input
source.help: 'radio' uses whatever sound device the radio in use is set to in Settings -> Radio, so it follows you between rigs. 'mock' synthesises Morse so the card works with no radio attached. Anything else is matched against the input's name, e.g. 'USB Audio CODEC'.

wrap.label: Wrap long lines
wrap.help: Off gives one long line per over, which some people prefer for reading a contest exchange.
